title: INTERFACE
body:
Alarms sound if you are detected. They also sound if
you are not. It's a feature. This is the robots'
network interface hub: tight corridors, electrified
floors and a building full of snitches. Alarm panels
and sentinels call in the hunters and power up the
floor grids, so shoot the watchers first. Take out the
uplink terminal to open the core, then leave.

captions.text: Slow to turn. Not to fire.
